title: Protection & Covering
intro: By now a teenager knows the world is not safe, and knows their parents cannot make it so. Pretending otherwise loses their trust. This month says the harder, truer thing — that they are covered rather than sheltered, that some protection is theirs to exercise, and that they were never meant to carry any of it alone.

keyScriptures.text: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.

weeks.title: Covered, Not Sheltered
weeks.declaration: You are not promised a life where nothing hard happens. You are promised that nothing hard happens to you alone, and that is a stronger thing than it sounds.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, we cannot make the world safe for our child. Cover them where we cannot, and let them know it. Amen.

weeks.title: Some Protection Is Yours to Use
weeks.declaration: What you watch, who you let close, where you go, when you leave. A great deal of your safety is in your own hands, and that is not a burden — it is authority.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, give our child the sense to guard what matters and the nerve to act on it. Amen.

weeks.title: Nothing Is Too Big to Say
weeks.declaration: There is no version of this where you are on your own with something. Whatever it is, it is smaller once it is said out loud.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, make us safe to tell. Keep our faces steady when our child brings us something hard. Amen.

weeks.title: Kept
weeks.declaration: You are kept — the way something valuable is kept, deliberately and by someone who intends to hold on.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, keep our child. When they are far from us and far from You, keep them still. Amen.

days.title: Covered, Not Exempt
days.declaration: You are not promised a life with no hard days. You are promised you will not face one alone.

scripture.text: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; when you walk through the fire, you will not be burned.

days.title: The Shelter Is Real
days.declaration: There is an actual place to go when everything is too much, and it is available at any hour.

scripture.text: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

days.title: Guard What Shapes You
days.declaration: What you take in shapes you. Guarding your heart is not fear; it is basic maintenance.

scripture.text: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.

days.title: Guard Your Eyes
days.declaration: What you look at repeatedly, you become used to. Deciding that on purpose is one of the most protective things you can do.

scripture.text: I will not look with approval on anything that is vile.

days.title: Leave Early
days.declaration: The best protection is often leaving twenty minutes before it gets complicated. That is not paranoia; it is skill.

scripture.text: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.

days.title: Who You Let Close
days.declaration: You get to decide who has access to you. That is not coldness, it is stewardship of something valuable.

scripture.text: Walk with the wise and become wise, for a companion of fools suffers harm.

days.title: Nothing Is Too Big to Say
days.declaration: There is no situation where you are on your own with it. It gets smaller the moment it is said out loud.

scripture.text: Pour out your hearts to him, for God is our refuge.

days.title: Secrets That Are Not Yours to Keep
days.declaration: If someone asks you to keep a secret that makes you unsafe, it was never your secret to keep.

scripture.text: Have nothing to do with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.

days.title: Watched Over
days.declaration: Someone is awake on your behalf. That is true at three in the morning as much as at midday.

scripture.text: He who watches over you will not slumber... will neither slumber nor sleep.

days.title: A Strong Tower
days.declaration: When everything is moving, there is one thing that does not. You can run to it without an appointment.

scripture.text: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.

days.title: Peace That Stands Guard
days.declaration: God's peace does not explain the situation. It stands guard over your mind while the situation is unresolved.

scripture.text: The peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds.

days.title: Anxiety, Handed Over
days.declaration: Anxiety is not a moral failure. It is a weight, and you were not built to carry it alone.

scripture.text: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.

days.title: Real Armour
days.declaration: You have been given real equipment for real pressure — truth, faith, peace. It is not a metaphor for trying harder.

scripture.text: Put on the full armour of God, so that you can take your stand.

days.title: Online Is a Real Place
days.declaration: What happens on a screen happens to an actual person. Protect yourself there as carefully as anywhere else.

scripture.text: The prudent see danger and take refuge.

days.title: You Are Allowed to Block
days.declaration: Removing someone's access to you is not rude. It is one of the few controls you actually have.

scripture.text: Do not set foot on the path of the wicked... turn from it and go on your way.

days.title: Rest Is Protection
days.declaration: Sleep is not laziness and it is not optional. A tired mind makes worse decisions and takes more damage.

scripture.text: He grants sleep to those he loves.

days.title: Not Surprised
days.declaration: Nothing about today caught God out. He is already in the part of it you cannot see yet.

scripture.text: You hem me in behind and before, and you lay your hand upon me.

days.title: Held When You Fall
days.declaration: Falling is not the same as being dropped. There are hands under you the whole way down.

scripture.text: Though he may stumble, he will not fall, for the Lord upholds him with his hand.

days.title: Words Aimed at You
days.declaration: What someone says about you is information about them. It does not have to become your inner voice.

scripture.text: No weapon forged against you will prevail, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you.

days.title: Ask for Help Early
days.declaration: Help asked for early is a conversation. Help asked for late is a crisis. Ask early.

scripture.text: If either of them falls down, one can help the other up.

days.title: Covered, Not Contained
days.declaration: You are covered so that you can go, not so that you stay small. Protection is what makes risk possible.

scripture.text: He brought me out into a spacious place; he rescued me because he delighted in me.

days.title: Your Body Is Worth Guarding
days.declaration: Looking after your body is not vanity. It is looking after the only one you were given.

scripture.text: Your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit.

days.title: Fear, Answered
days.declaration: When fear tells you a story at night, you are allowed to answer it with something truer.

scripture.text: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.

days.title: Never Abandoned
days.declaration: You will not be abandoned — not when you are difficult, not when you are far away, not when you have gone quiet.

scripture.text: Never will I leave you; never will I forsake you.

days.title: The Cost of Isolation
days.declaration: Isolation makes everything more dangerous. Whatever is happening, do not go through it on your own.

scripture.text: Whoever isolates himself seeks his own desire.

days.title: Boundaries Are Kind
days.declaration: A boundary is not a punishment you hand someone. It is a description of what you can sustain.

scripture.text: Each one should carry their own load.

days.title: Prayed For
days.declaration: You are prayed for when you are not in the room and when you have no idea. You are covered by more than you can see.

scripture.text: Pray for each other so that you may be healed.

days.title: Return Is Always Open
days.declaration: However far you go, the way back is not closed. That is the whole point of who God is.

scripture.text: While he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion.

days.title: Kept
days.declaration: You are kept — the way something valuable is kept, deliberately, by someone who intends to hold on.

scripture.text: The Lord bless you and keep you.

days.title: Safe to Be Weak
days.declaration: You do not have to be strong all the time. It is safe to be tired here, and safe to be tired with God.

scripture.text: He gathers the lambs in his arms and carries them close to his heart.

days.title: Carry It Forward
days.declaration: Nothing about being covered changes when the month does. Take it with you.

scripture.text: The Lord will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore.
